concrete_arithmetic_counterexample.explanation: 5 divides 10, so the relative decomposition-group intersection is trivial, but 2 is not 1 modulo 31

conditional_salvage.hypothesis: accept all earlier arguments of the preprint through the relative splitting statement for the even prime divisor
conditional_salvage.necessary_condition: ord_q(2) divides ord_p(2), hence q divides 2^ord_p(2)-1

counterexample.consequence: D intersection H={1} does not imply D subset G and does not imply the fixed field of D contains the H-cyclotomic factor

frobenius_correction.claimed_absolute_split_condition: ell splits completely in Q(zeta_q) iff n=1
frobenius_correction.corrected_implication: relative splitting over Q(zeta_p) implies ord_q(ell) divides ord_p(ell), not ord_q(ell)=1
frobenius_correction.relative_split_condition: D intersection H={1} iff n divides m
frobenius_correction.setup: for an unramified rational prime ell, let m=ord_p(ell), n=ord_q(ell), and D=<Frob_ell> in C_m x C_n

impact: the preprint's final parity contradiction is not established; it cannot currently be imported as a proof of all repeated-prime sum signatures
nonclaim: this audit does not disprove the theorem stated in the preprint; it identifies a specific invalid inference and records the weaker conclusion that would follow from the stated relative splitting premise
